payload.definition_title: Actual finite-set conductors and the Belyi image-field different
payload.definition:
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: The heights contributors

Independent source adaptation; validation and source mappings are recorded with this unit.
-/
import Definitions.Def_FermatBelyiComparisons
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.NumberField.Discriminant.Different

set_option autoImplicit false
open NumberField
open scoped Classical IntermediateField

namespace AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper

/-- Exactly Heights.Different.cond, with the finite-place norm expanded. -/
noncomputable def finiteSetLogCond {F : Type*} [Field F] [NumberField F]
    (S : Finset F) : ℝ :=
  (∑ᶠ w : FinitePlace F,
    if ∃ a ∈ S, 1 < w a then Real.log (Ideal.absNorm w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) else 0) /
      Module.finrank ℚ F

noncomputable def tripodConductorGenerators (y : Tripod.Pt) :
    Finset (Tripod.fieldOf y.1) :=
  {Tripod.gen y.1, (Tripod.gen y.1)⁻¹, (1 - Tripod.gen y.1)⁻¹}

noncomputable def evaluatedCuspGenerators {N : ℕ} {M : Model N}
    (x : QbarPoint M.K) (G : Finset M.K) (hG : ∀ g ∈ G, g ∈ x.P.1) :
    Finset x.fieldOf :=
  G.attach.image (fun g => evalInPointField x g.1 (hG g.1 g.2))

/-- The actual image-field inclusion fixes the algebra used by the relative different.
The denominator is the full residue-image field degree. -/
noncomputable def belyiRelativeLogDifferent {N : ℕ} (M : Model N)
    (hRF : ResiduesFinite M) (φ : M.K) (x : QbarPoint M.K)
    (hgood : GoodValue M x φ) : ℝ := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ x.fieldOf := pointField_finiteDimensional M hRF x
  letI : Algebra (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1) x.fieldOf :=
    (IntermediateField.inclusion (belyiImage_field_le M φ x hgood)).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  exact Real.log (Ideal.absNorm
    (differentIdeal (𝓞 (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1)) (𝓞 x.fieldOf))) /
      x.degree

/-- Source numeric child: no curve field, height, or number field is supplied freely.
Both fields are fixed by the actual x and actual φ(x). S,T are actual finite element sets. -/
def BelyiActualFieldConductorExtension : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M) (φ : M.K)
    (x : QbarPoint M.K) (hgood : GoodValue M x φ),
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ x.fieldOf := pointField_finiteDimensional M hRF x
    ∀ (S : Finset (Tripod.fieldOf (belyiImage M φ x).1)) (T : Finset x.fieldOf),
      S.image (IntermediateField.inclusion (belyiImage_field_le M φ x hgood)) ⊆ T →
      finiteSetLogCond S ≤ finiteSetLogCond T +
        belyiRelativeLogDifferent M hRF φ x hgood

/-- The actual full-field different tower identity. Image and point degrees stay distinct. -/
def BelyiActualFieldDifferentTower : Prop :=
  ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M) (φ : M.K)
    (x : QbarPoint M.K) (hgood : GoodValue M x φ),
      pointLogDiff M hRF x = Tripod.logDiff (belyiImage M φ x) +
        belyiRelativeLogDifferent M hRF φ x hgood

/-- Numeric identification for the three actual tripod generators. -/
def TripodGeneratorConductorIdentity : Prop :=
  ∀ y : Tripod.Pt, Tripod.logCond y = finiteSetLogCond (tripodConductorGenerators y)

end AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper
payload.natural_language_statement:
# Mochizuki original-paper context for the different/conductor route

Author: Shinichi Mochizuki. Title: *Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position*. PDF title-page date: **February 2009**.

Official PDF: https://www.kurims.kyoto-u.ac.jp/~motizuki/Arithmetic%20Elliptic%20Curves%20in%20General%20Position.pdf

Local PDF: `/home/admin-wsl/Coq/abc/refer/Mochizuki/Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position.pdf`

SHA-256: `b9dc115af61dca7fe434332ebafddf6a376a9e2926dad4e1ea2dcc0d2441f768`

HTTP HEAD 200; application/pdf; Content-Length 262332; 2026-11-14. Existing local PDF used; not downloaded.

Printed page numbers coincide with 1-based PDF page numbers.

Ghostscript txtwrite, followed by visual checking of the rasterized PDF pages. Line wrapping and typographic ligatures normalized; mathematical typography transcribed as LaTeX. Words and mathematical relation signs preserved.

**Version warning:** The existing Markdown transcription is not this PDF version: it says March 2008, while the actual PDF title page says February 2009; its Theorem 2.1 proof also differs. Do not use it as an exact-quotation source.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Prop1.7i

Proposition 1.7(i), statement; printed/PDF pages: [9, 10].

(i) If we restrict functions on $Z(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$, $U_Z(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$ to $U_Y(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$ via $\phi$, then
\[
\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E-\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_D\lesssim\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_Y-\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_Z\lesssim\left(1-\frac{1}{e}\right)\cdot\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E
\]
on $U_Y(\overline{\mathbb{Q}})$.

Context (not quotation): Here φ:Y→Z is a generically finite morphism of normal Z-proper Z-flat dimension-two schemes; D and E are effective Z-flat Cartier divisors with reduced generic fibers, D_Q=φ_Q^{-1}(E_Q)_red, finite étale restriction off the divisors, and ramification indices along D_Q dividing e. The statement uses BD-class comparisons (≲), not an exact numerical finite-set inequality.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Prop1.7-localClaim

Proposition 1.7(i), proof, indented elementary claim; printed/PDF pages: [10].

Fix a prime number $p$ and a positive integer $d$. Then there exists a positive integer $n$ such that for any finite Galois extension $L/K$ of finite extensions of $\mathbb{Q}_p$ with $[L:K]\leq d$, the different ideal of $L/K$ contains $p^n\cdot\mathcal{O}_L$ [where we write $\mathcal{O}_L$ for the ring of integers of $L$].

Context (not quotation): The preceding proof paragraph reduces boundedness of the portion over a finite set Σ of log-diff_Y−log-diff_Z to this elementary local claim. This is supporting background, not the exact new finite-set conductor-extension child.

## Mochizuki-GenEll-Thm2.1-BelyiDescent

Theorem 2.1, proof, first paragraph on printed page 13 (selected complete sentences); printed/PDF pages: [13].

On the other hand, by choosing appropriate normal, $\mathbb{Z}$-proper, $\mathbb{Z}$-flat models for $P$, $X$, we may apply Proposition 1.7, (i) [where we take “$e$” to be 1], to conclude that $\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_P+\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_C\lesssim\mathrm{log\text{-}diff}_X+\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E$ on $\Xi$. Also, we recall from Proposition 1.6 that $\mathrm{log\text{-}cond}_E\lesssim\mathrm{ht}_E\stackrel{\mathrm{def}}{=}\mathrm{ht}_{\mathcal{O}_X(E)}$ on $\Xi$. Thus, by Proposition 1.4, (i), (iii), we compute to find that

Context (not quotation): On printed page 12, φ:X→P is the noncritical Belyi map unramified over U_P, C={0,1,∞}, and E=φ^{-1}(C)_red. The paragraph continues with the displayed height calculation. The first complete quoted sentence is sufficient for the different/conductor comparison route; the additional sentences show its immediate height consumer.

## Scope and fidelity

Proposition 1.7(i) and its use in Theorem 2.1 establish the paper-level geometric/BD-class different–conductor comparison used by Belyi descent.

BelyiActualFieldConductorExtension fixes F=Tripod.fieldOf(belyiImage M φ x).1 and L=x.fieldOf, finite element sets S⊂F, T⊂L, and the actual field inclusion. Under inclusion(S)⊆T it asks for finiteSetLogCond(S)≤finiteSetLogCond(T)+log(absNorm(differentIdeal(O_F,O_L)))/[L:Q].

The paper does not state this exact finite-set formula or these Lean field definitions. Treat the quoted paragraph as original-paper context, and identify the finite-set inequality as an explicit field-level arithmetic auxiliary lemma implementing that context. Do not put the exact new numeric statement inside quotation marks or claim it is a verbatim theorem of Mochizuki.

BelyiActualFieldDifferentTower separately identifies the full-field log-different with the image-field log-different plus the normalized relative different. The paper quotation does not by itself prove either current Lean child.

Recommended short citation: Mochizuki, *Arithmetic Elliptic Curves in General Position*, February 2009 PDF, Theorem 2.1 proof, printed/PDF p. 13; supporting statement Proposition 1.7(i), pp. 9–10.

**English**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.finiteSetLogCond`

For every type $E$ equipped with a field structure and a number-field structure and every finite set $S\subset E$, this defines the real number $c_E(S)=\bigl(\sum_w^{\mathrm f} [\exists a\in S:\ w(a)>1]\log N_E(\mathfrak p_w)\bigr)/[E:\mathbb Q]$. The sum ranges over all finite places $w$ of $E$, each contributing the logarithm of the absolute norm of its maximal ideal in $\mathcal O_E$ exactly when some element of $S$ has $w$-value greater than one, and zero otherwise. It is the finite-support sum, not an archimedean sum. The set is arbitrary, can contain zero and can be empty; the empty set gives zero. No integrality or generating condition is imposed.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.tripodConductorGenerators`

For every algebraic number $z\in\overline{\mathbb Q}$ with $z\ne0,1$, regarded as a tripod point $y$, this defines the finite subset $\{z,z^{-1},(1-z)^{-1}\}$ of the simple number field $\mathbb Q(z)$, using its canonical generator whose image in $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ is $z$. Repeated elements are identified because this is a finite set, not a list.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.evaluatedCuspGenerators`

Let $N$ be any natural number and let $M$ consist of an intermediate field $K$ of $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q(t)}$ over $\mathbb Q$, elements $u,v\in K$ with $u$ transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$, and a finite extension $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ of degree $N$. A point $x=(P,\sigma)$ means a nontrivial valuation subring $P\subset K$ containing $\mathbb Q$, together with any residue-field embedding $\sigma:\kappa(P)\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$. For $f\in P$, write $f(x)=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_P(f))$; write $L=\sigma(\kappa(P))$ for the full point field and $d_L=[L:\mathbb Q]$. All choices of $P$ and $\sigma$ are quantified. For any finite subset $G\subset K$ and a proof that every $g\in G$ lies in $P$, this defines the finite subset $\{g(x):g\in G\}\subset L$. Each value is taken in the full residue-image field $L$. The finite image identifies repeated values; $G$ may be empty and need not generate any ring or contain the three distinguished functions.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiRelativeLogDifferent`

Let $N$ be any natural number and let $M$ consist of an intermediate field $K$ of $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q(t)}$ over $\mathbb Q$, elements $u,v\in K$ with $u$ transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$, and a finite extension $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ of degree $N$. A point $x=(P,\sigma)$ means a nontrivial valuation subring $P\subset K$ containing $\mathbb Q$, together with any residue-field embedding $\sigma:\kappa(P)\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$. For $f\in P$, write $f(x)=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_P(f))$; write $L=\sigma(\kappa(P))$ for the full point field and $d_L=[L:\mathbb Q]$. All choices of $P$ and $\sigma$ are quantified. Assume $\kappa(Q)$ is finite dimensional over $\mathbb Q$ for every such valuation subring $Q$ of $K$; this supplies the number-field structure on $L$. Let $\varphi\in K$ be regular at $P$ with $z=\varphi(x)\ne0,1$. Put $F=\mathbb Q(z)\subseteq L$, with its actual inclusion $i:F\hookrightarrow L$, and $d_F=[F:\mathbb Q]$. This defines $r(L/F)=\log N_L(\mathfrak D_{L/F})/d_L$, with $\mathfrak D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ formed with the algebra structure induced by the actual inclusion $i$. The denominator is the full residue-image degree $d_L$, not $d_F$ or $[L:F]$. No Belyi condition or discreteness assumption on the curve places is required.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.BelyiActualFieldConductorExtension`

Let $N$ be any natural number and let $M$ consist of an intermediate field $K$ of $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q(t)}$ over $\mathbb Q$, elements $u,v\in K$ with $u$ transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$, and a finite extension $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ of degree $N$. A point $x=(P,\sigma)$ means a nontrivial valuation subring $P\subset K$ containing $\mathbb Q$, together with any residue-field embedding $\sigma:\kappa(P)\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$. For $f\in P$, write $f(x)=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_P(f))$; write $L=\sigma(\kappa(P))$ for the full point field and $d_L=[L:\mathbb Q]$. All choices of $P$ and $\sigma$ are quantified. Assume $\kappa(Q)$ is finite dimensional over $\mathbb Q$ for every such valuation subring $Q$ of $K$; this supplies the number-field structure on $L$. Let $\varphi\in K$ be regular at $P$ with $z=\varphi(x)\ne0,1$. Put $F=\mathbb Q(z)\subseteq L$, with its actual inclusion $i:F\hookrightarrow L$, and $d_F=[F:\mathbb Q]$. For a number field $E$ and a finite subset $A\subset E$, define $c_E(A)=\bigl(\sum_w^{\mathrm f} [\exists a\in A:\ w(a)>1]\log N_E(\mathfrak p_w)\bigr)/[E:\mathbb Q]$, where $w$ ranges over every finite place of $E$, $\mathfrak p_w$ is its maximal ideal in $\mathcal O_E$, $N_E$ is absolute ideal norm, and a false bracket contributes zero. The superscript denotes the formal finite-support sum. Write $\delta(E)=\log|\operatorname{disc}(E)|/[E:\mathbb Q]$ and $r(L/F)=\log N_L(\mathfrak D_{L/F})/d_L$, where the relative different ideal $\mathfrak D_{L/F}$ is formed from $\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ using $i$. The two field degrees are not identified. The proposition says that, universally for the data just described, for every finite $S\subset F$ and every finite $T\subset L$, $i(S)\subseteq T$ implies $c_F(S)\le c_L(T)+r(L/F)$. The sets are arbitrary, including empty sets; no generating or integrality condition is added. No Belyi or discrete-valuation condition is part of this proposition.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.BelyiActualFieldDifferentTower`

Let $N$ be any natural number and let $M$ consist of an intermediate field $K$ of $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q(t)}$ over $\mathbb Q$, elements $u,v\in K$ with $u$ transcendental over $\mathbb Q$, $u^N+v^N=1$, $\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$, and a finite extension $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ of degree $N$. A point $x=(P,\sigma)$ means a nontrivial valuation subring $P\subset K$ containing $\mathbb Q$, together with any residue-field embedding $\sigma:\kappa(P)\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$. For $f\in P$, write $f(x)=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_P(f))$; write $L=\sigma(\kappa(P))$ for the full point field and $d_L=[L:\mathbb Q]$. All choices of $P$ and $\sigma$ are quantified. Assume $\kappa(Q)$ is finite dimensional over $\mathbb Q$ for every such valuation subring $Q$ of $K$; this supplies the number-field structure on $L$. Let $\varphi\in K$ be regular at $P$ with $z=\varphi(x)\ne0,1$. Put $F=\mathbb Q(z)\subseteq L$, with its actual inclusion $i:F\hookrightarrow L$, and $d_F=[F:\mathbb Q]$. Write $\delta(E)=\log|\operatorname{disc}(E)|/[E:\mathbb Q]$ and $r(L/F)=\log N_L(\mathfrak D_{L/F})/d_L$, where the relative different ideal $\mathfrak D_{L/F}$ is formed from $\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ using $i$. The two field degrees are not identified. The proposition says that, universally for these data, $\delta(L)=\delta(F)+r(L/F)$. The image discriminant is normalized by $d_F$ and the full point discriminant and relative different by $d_L$. No equality of the fields or of their degrees is required.

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.TripodGeneratorConductorIdentity`

For a number field $E$ and a finite subset $A\subset E$, define $c_E(A)=\bigl(\sum_w^{\mathrm f} [\exists a\in A:\ w(a)>1]\log N_E(\mathfrak p_w)\bigr)/[E:\mathbb Q]$, where $w$ ranges over every finite place of $E$, $\mathfrak p_w$ is its maximal ideal in $\mathcal O_E$, $N_E$ is absolute ideal norm, and a false bracket contributes zero. The superscript denotes the formal finite-support sum. For every $z\in\overline{\mathbb Q}$ with $z\ne0,1$, put $F=\mathbb Q(z)$ and regard $z$ as the canonical generator of $F$. The proposition says that $\bigl(\sum_w^{\mathrm f}[w(z)\ne1\ \vee\ w(z-1)\ne1]\log N_F(\mathfrak p_w)\bigr)/[F:\mathbb Q]=c_F(\{z,z^{-1},(1-z)^{-1}\})$. The sum is over every finite place of $F$, the norm is the absolute norm of its prime ideal in $\mathcal O_F$, false conditions contribute zero, and the finite set removes repetitions.

**简体中文**

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.finiteSetLogCond`

对任意带域结构和数域结构的类型 $E$ 及有限集 $S\subset E$，本定义给出实数 $c_E(S)=\bigl(\sum_w^{\mathrm f} [\exists a\in S:\ w(a)>1]\log N_E(\mathfrak p_w)\bigr)/[E:\mathbb Q]$。$w$ 遍及 $E$ 的全部有限处；当且仅当 $S$ 中某个元素的 $w$ 值严格大于一时，该处贡献 $\mathcal O_E$ 中相应极大理想的绝对范数的对数，否则贡献零。这里使用有限支撑求和，不包含无限处。$S$ 任意，可以含零或为空；空集的值为零。不要求元素为整元，也不要求 $S$ 生成域或环。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.tripodConductorGenerators`

对任意 $z\in\overline{\mathbb Q}$、$z\ne0,1$，将其视为点 $y$，本定义在单生成数域 $\mathbb Q(z)$ 中给出有限集 $\{z,z^{-1},(1-z)^{-1}\}$，其中用像为 $z$ 的典范生成元表示 $z$。这是有限集，重复元素只保留一次。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.evaluatedCuspGenerators`

设 $N$ 为任意自然数，$M$ 给出 $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q(t)}$ 的一个 $\mathbb Q$ 上中间域 $K$ 以及 $u,v\in K$，满足 $u$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$，且 $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ 是次数为 $N$ 的有限扩张。点 $x=(P,\sigma)$ 由包含 $\mathbb Q$ 的非平凡赋值子环 $P\subset K$ 和任意剩余域嵌入 $\sigma:\kappa(P)\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 组成。对 $f\in P$，记 $f(x)=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_P(f))$；完整点域记为 $L=\sigma(\kappa(P))$，并记 $d_L=[L:\mathbb Q]$。量词遍及所有这样的 $P$ 和 $\sigma$。对任意有限集 $G\subset K$ 及每个 $g\in G$ 都属于 $P$ 的证明，本定义给出 $L$ 中的有限集 $\{g(x):g\in G\}$。每个取值都位于完整剩余像域 $L$ 中。有限像集将相同取值合并；$G$ 可以为空，不要求生成某个环，也不要求包含三个指定函数。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiRelativeLogDifferent`

设 $N$ 为任意自然数，$M$ 给出 $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q(t)}$ 的一个 $\mathbb Q$ 上中间域 $K$ 以及 $u,v\in K$，满足 $u$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$，且 $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ 是次数为 $N$ 的有限扩张。点 $x=(P,\sigma)$ 由包含 $\mathbb Q$ 的非平凡赋值子环 $P\subset K$ 和任意剩余域嵌入 $\sigma:\kappa(P)\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 组成。对 $f\in P$，记 $f(x)=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_P(f))$；完整点域记为 $L=\sigma(\kappa(P))$，并记 $d_L=[L:\mathbb Q]$。量词遍及所有这样的 $P$ 和 $\sigma$。假设 $K$ 的每个上述赋值子环 $Q$ 的剩余域 $\kappa(Q)$ 都在 $\mathbb Q$ 上有限维；由此赋予 $L$ 数域结构。取 $\varphi\in K$，要求 $\varphi\in P$ 且 $z=\varphi(x)\ne0,1$。记 $F=\mathbb Q(z)\subseteq L$，$i:F\hookrightarrow L$ 为实际包含映射，$d_F=[F:\mathbb Q]$。本定义给出 $r(L/F)=\log N_L(\mathfrak D_{L/F})/d_L$，其中 $\mathfrak D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ 使用实际包含 $i$ 所诱导的代数结构构造，$N_L$ 为理想的绝对范数。分母是完整剩余像域的次数 $d_L$，不是 $d_F$ 或 $[L:F]$。不要求 Belyi 条件，也不要求曲线各处的赋值环离散。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.BelyiActualFieldConductorExtension`

设 $N$ 为任意自然数，$M$ 给出 $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q(t)}$ 的一个 $\mathbb Q$ 上中间域 $K$ 以及 $u,v\in K$，满足 $u$ 在 $\mathbb Q$ 上超越、$u^N+v^N=1$、$\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$，且 $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ 是次数为 $N$ 的有限扩张。点 $x=(P,\sigma)$ 由包含 $\mathbb Q$ 的非平凡赋值子环 $P\subset K$ 和任意剩余域嵌入 $\sigma:\kappa(P)\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$ 组成。对 $f\in P$，记 $f(x)=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_P(f))$；完整点域记为 $L=\sigma(\kappa(P))$，并记 $d_L=[L:\mathbb Q]$。量词遍及所有这样的 $P$ 和 $\sigma$。假设 $K$ 的每个上述赋值子环 $Q$ 的剩余域 $\kappa(Q)$ 都在 $\mathbb Q$ 上有限维；由此赋予 $L$ 数域结构。取 $\varphi\in K$，要求 $\varphi\in P$ 且 $z=\varphi(x)\ne0,1$。记 $F=\mathbb Q(z)\subseteq L$，$i:F\hookrightarrow L$ 为实际包含映射，$d_F=[F:\mathbb Q]$。对数域 $E$ 及其有限子集 $A$，定义 $c_E(A)=\bigl(\sum_w^{\mathrm f} [\exists a\in A:\ w(a)>1]\log N_E(\mathfrak p_w)\bigr)/[E:\mathbb Q]$。这里 $w$ 遍及 $E$ 的全部有限处，$\mathfrak p_w$ 是 $\mathcal O_E$ 中相应的极大理想，$N_E$ 为理想的绝对范数，方括号内条件不成立时该项为零；上标表示形式代码中的有限支撑求和。记 $\delta(E)=\log|\operatorname{disc}(E)|/[E:\mathbb Q]$，$r(L/F)=\log N_L(\mathfrak D_{L/F})/d_L$，其中相对不同理想 $\mathfrak D_{L/F}$ 使用 $i$ 所诱导的 $\mathcal O_F\to\mathcal O_L$ 构造。这里不把两个域的次数视为相等。此命题断言：对上述所有数据，以及任意有限集 $S\subset F$、$T\subset L$，若 $i(S)\subseteq T$，则 $c_F(S)\le c_L(T)+r(L/F)$。两个集合任意，包括空集，不附加生成或整性条件。此命题不含 Belyi 条件或离散赋值条件。

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.BelyiActualFieldDifferentTower`

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.finiteSetLogCond`

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.evaluatedCuspGenerators`

`AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiRelativeLogDifferent`

$N$ を任意の自然数とする。$M$ は $\Omega=\overline{\mathbb Q(t)}$ の $\mathbb Q$ 上の中間体 $K$ と元 $u,v\in K$ からなり、$u$ は $\mathbb Q$ 上超越的、$u^N+v^N=1$、$\mathbb Q(u,v)=K$、かつ $K/\mathbb Q(u)$ は次数 $N$ の有限拡大である。点 $x=(P,\sigma)$ は $\mathbb Q$ を含む非自明な付値部分環 $P\subset K$ と任意の剰余体埋め込み $\sigma:\kappa(P)\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$ からなる。$f\in P$ に対して $f(x)=\sigma(\operatorname{res}_P(f))$ と置き、点の全体の体を $L=\sigma(\kappa(P))$、その次数を $d_L=[L:\mathbb Q]$ と書く。すべての $P$ と $\sigma$ が量化されている。$K$ のこのようなすべての付値部分環 $Q$ の剰余体 $\kappa(Q)$ が $\mathbb Q$ 上有限次元であると仮定する。これにより $L$ は数体となる。$\varphi\in K$ が $P$ で正則であり、$z=\varphi(x)\ne0,1$ とする。$F=\mathbb Q(z)\subseteq L$ とし、$i:F\hookrightarrow L$ を実際の包含写像、$d_F=[F:\mathbb Q]$ をその次数とする。$r(L/F)=\log N_L(\mathfrak D_{L/F})/d_L$ を定義する。$N_L$ はイデアルの絶対ノルムであり、$\mathfrak D_{L/F}=\operatorname{differentIdeal}(\mathcal O_F,\mathcal O_L)$ は実際の包含 $i$ による代数構造を用いる。分母は剰余体の像全体の次数 $d_L$ であり、$d_F$ や $[L:F]$ ではない。Belyi 条件や曲線の各付値環の離散性は仮定しない。
